# Columbia University - IRI Data Library

> Free, open-access climate data repository with advanced analysis and visualization tools for researchers and practitioners worldwide.

The IRI Data Library, operated by Columbia University's International Research Institute for Climate and Society and Lamont-Doherty Earth Observatory, provides comprehensive climate datasets and analysis capabilities. It serves as a critical resource for climate research, monitoring, and decision-making across multiple disciplines and regions.

## Key Topics

- IRI Data Library
- Climate data repository
- Ingrid Data Analysis Language
- International Research Institute for Climate and Society
- Lamont-Doherty Earth Observatory
- Data visualization
- Climate monitoring
- Maproom
- EOF (Empirical Orthogonal Function)
- GIS integration
- Free access
- Download formats
- Data analysis tools
- Multilingual support

## Climate Data Repository

- [Climate Data Library](https://iridl.ldeo.columbia.edu/): IRI Data Library: free climate data repository with analysis and download tools
